description: This is a PHP class named 'ReviewerRatingDecorator' within the OrangeHRM project. It functions as a decorator for the 'ReviewerRating' entity, providing methods to access and modify the associated reviewer rating and linked KPI.

classes.name: ReviewerRatingDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for ReviewerRating entity, adding functionality to set KPI by ID and access the reviewer rating.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a ReviewerRating instance.

methods.name: setKpiByKpiId
methods.description: Sets the KPI associated with the reviewer rating by its ID.
